content:
tvOS 27 is the latest system update for Apple TV 4K and is now rolling out to all users. Here's an introduction to the new features in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 adds a newly redesigned Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text sizes, and more

tvOS 27 can now be installed via the "Settings" app on Apple TV. This update is compatible with all Apple TV 4K models (except the first generation); Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's tvOS 27 update includes the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts gets a major revamp on tvOS, following the design direction of the iOS update earlier this year. The new tvOS Podcasts app fully supports Apple's video features, making it easy to watch video podcasts. The interface also features a fresh design with a sidebar navigation, delivering a smoother user experience.

Updating via iPhone: tvOS 27 introduces a convenient new feature that lets users update their Apple TV 4K system directly from their iPhone. Through the "Home" app in iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without needing to turn on your Apple TV.

Apple Music upgrade: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix comes to Apple TV, offering DJ-style transitions between songs that are perfect for parties. Hi-Res Lossless Audio has also been added, though it requires a compatible external speaker for output.

Larger text size: Users can now adjust the overall system text size in the "Settings" app using the "Dynamic Type" feature, making it easier to read from your couch in different viewing environments.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations, faster app launch times, and more responsive Control Center.

Missing features: Siri AI and smart downloads

Notably, tvOS 27 does not include the new Siri AI assistant—only the older version of Siri. Reports suggest this is because the new Apple TV 4K, launching soon with more powerful hardware, is needed to support Siri AI.

Another upgrade that's missing in action is the "smart downloads" feature Apple mentioned at WWDC. tvOS has never supported downloads for TV content, so the announcement came as a surprise. "Smart downloads" may refer to certain system-related features rather than TV shows and movies. Either way, there's no sign of this feature in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How does it feel to use? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
